items.title: Jim Robinson Interview, 1961-07-13
items.q: I know Billy and the Dee used to be around that too.

ctx.x: All right, right around there. But it was at the corner.
I know Billy and the Dee used to be around that too.
Yeah, well they had three or four pieces in all that block. All around there, three or four pieces.

items.title: Percy Humphrey Band: Percy Humphrey, Jim Robinson, Ernest Roubleau, Josiah Frazier Interview, 1972-02-29
items.q: Her and her husband do the singing.

ctx.x: That's the main thing. They want you to hear the voice of the thing.

You understand? Dave, Dave written a team for Billy. You don't know that. Oh, she ain't going to hear the voice. Dave written a team for you. Give her the voice. Kimmel sang it. You came with Kimmel sang it. But he made the voice for it. Yeah. People want you to hear the voice. Good boy. The people sing it. They know the number, but they want you to sing it the number. Her and her husband do the singing. But that's that main department. So I don't get in that.

I get something. Make me Willie play his solo. I play mine. Then he gets a bit. People want you to sing that thing. Tell them the words what you're doing. If you're saying the right words, what's in that book?
